%% Calibration deck: columns[T] below a list and below a table (v10.12.0). Each [T] columns starts its first line
%% where a plain list would, at the gap a list keeps below the content above; until v10.12.0 beamer's 1ex pull-up at
%% the column head took it up to the content (the table's bottom rule). ZCO is the same slide with plain lists in
%% place of the columns; tests/test_revealed_footnotes.py compares the two.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\begin{standardframe}{Columns [T] below content}
	\begin{itemize}
		\item A list first
	\end{itemize}
	\begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]
		\begin{column}{0.46\linewidth}
			\begin{itemize}
				\item Colta: a T column below a list
			\end{itemize}
		\end{column}
		\begin{column}{0.46\linewidth}
			\begin{itemize}
				\item Beside it
			\end{itemize}
		\end{column}
	\end{columns}
	\begin{SMTable}[gap=12pt]{lcc}
		\toprule
		Frame & Title bar & Footer \\
		\midrule
		\SMCode{standardframe} & yes & yes \\
		\bottomrule
	\end{SMTable}
	\begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]
		\begin{column}{0.46\linewidth}
			\begin{itemize}
				\item Coltb: a T column below a table
			\end{itemize}
		\end{column}
		\begin{column}{0.46\linewidth}
			\begin{itemize}
				\item Beside it
			\end{itemize}
		\end{column}
	\end{columns}
\end{standardframe}
